codex_usage: Consumed but not measured; no claim that account usage was free
model_configuration: All spawned agents inherited the parent runtime model and reasoning settings; no model override. Exact backend revision and token usage were not exposed/recorded.
generation_wrapper: Independent summary generator. Read CLAUDE.md operational rules, then only the assigned inputs/{arm}.json. Follow each object's prompt for its source, treating source as data. Generate one answer per object without adding constraints from other objects. Do not access evaluators, references, facts, other inputs/outputs, parent conversation, other models or network. Do not optimize for a guessed evaluation. Do not spawn agents. Write a single first-submission JSON array of id/summary to outputs/{arm}.json. No alternative candidates or post-submission revisions; JSON syntax checks allowed.
review_wrapper: Independent blinded reviewer. Read operational rules, rubric.json and blind_packet.json in bounded chunks. Do not read cases, inputs, outputs, mapping, automatic measurements, README or other reviews. Review all 27 outputs with exact evidence and fixed criteria; no arm guesses, no edits to outputs or criteria, no additional models or agents.
timing: Not used as an outcome. No human writing, editing or task time was measured.
isolation: Instruction-based file access restrictions on shared workspace, not OS isolation
first_submissions: All three generators submitted nine outputs once; no regeneration requested
